items.text: We have an important update regarding the upcoming launch of Chessarama on Android.

We've made the difficult decision to move the release date from August 18th to a new date in early September. This extra time will allow our team to implement more optimizations and improvements to ensure we deliver the best possible game experience for you on day one! 💙

Our commitment is to quality, and we believe this short delay will make a significant difference. We sincerely apologize for this change of plans and are incredibly grateful for your patience and excitement. Your support means the world to us.
Pre-registration on the Google Play Store remains open. We will announce the final launch date as soon as it is confirmed.
Howdy, everyone!
It's been a long time since our last Patch Notes. In the last months, we've been working on diverse updates, features, and some very cool things 👀
We're happy to finally share some of the updates we worked on!
Time options and board selection for Chess Matches;
Badge rewards for Leaderboards.
When playing with controller, in rare occasions entering the Live Challenges screen will lock interaction;
When playing with controller, in rare occasions entering a Chess Match will make pieces disappear;
The daily challenge that requires wins without moving the King needs one more win than displayed.

It's possible to get locked in Chess Match after finishing and trying to play again. We'll fix ASAP, in the meantime, go back to the Main Menu and start a new Chess Match game and it will work without problems.
Stay tuned to check the updates we're working on. We can't wait to share everything with you 💙
Keep reporting bugs and giving us feedback on the Steam Community Hub or in our Discord server! 💪

Hello everyone!
Today we're updating Chessarama to the 1.1.4 version. Take a look on what's new 😄
We have cleared out how Battles Challenges persist! Progress made on them is saved only at the end of the Battles match, so the following actions will lose progress:
Restarting a Battles match;
Going to the Main Menu in the middle of a Battles match;
Force closing the game in the middle of a Battles match.
It's no longer necessary to accept data collection to play Chessarama! 💙
Clicking to open the Codex on tips will now open it contextually as intended;
Fixed a bug where pieces information were not fully displayed in Codex;
Fixed a text error on the Rook section in Street Soccer Codex;
Fixed a bug where Collections items were sometimes blocked after opening the game;
Fixed a bug where Chess set achievements were being incorrectly given.
Chess Set achievements aren't properly rewarded when completing all Battles challenges;
There's a bug causing some tutorial UI to be a little displaced;
The achievements related to Live Challenges aren't triggering;
The term "Live Challenges" isn't translated in-game to other languages;
Sometimes the Tip buttons are not in the right places after accessing the Codex;
Sometimes the Soccer Chess tutorial doesn't work properly, requiring the game to be restarted;
Sometimes the reward screen is not shown;
Some settings options are not being saved correctly;
The Christmas Set is not unlocking correctly;
At times, the loading icon is incorrectly displayed during the results.
Keep reporting bugs and giving us feedback on the Steam Community Hub or in our Discord server! 💪
Howdy, Chessarama fans!
Today we are publishing a new build, with some important updates and fixes. Let's first list all fixes and then discuss the issue we had with data persistence and how it impacted our players.
Live Challenges achievements are now properly triggering;
The term "Live Challenges" is properly translated in-game to other languages;
The "Win without moving your pieces into a Fenced tile" challenge was changed in Knight Supreme to make it more persistent;
Fixed an error in data persistence (more below).

As a few players noted, the last update had the undesired side effect of making previously completed Challenges to become uncompleted. Our team worked hard in the last few days to understand what happened as well as to implement a more robust solution going forward.

notes.title: Here is a summary of the issue

items.text: We use Playfab as our tool to manage the "live" part of the game, such as the Leaderboards, XPs, Live Challenges, etc. We identified an unexpected bug in how the game communicates with Playfab, which resulted in some lost progress data (more on that below).
What are the consequences?
Every player lost their "challenges" progress (but not the XP associated with it);
No player lost their XP - this data is solid and correct;
No player lost Steam Achievements;
No player lost level progression;
No other consequence was identified.
Here is what you can expect from the current build (v1.1.3) onward:

After a lot of revisions, tests, and dedication from our team, we identified the bug and corrected it. Everything should work as expected now regarding the challenges, XP, and general player progress;
However, as explained above, all players lost their "Challenge" progression (but didn't lose the XP associated with it);
If you decide to re-do those challenges, you will earn more XP - so in some sense, this is a "good" side-effect (and unavoidable consequence) of the issue.

So, this is the current state of the game and the bug has been fixed. We are reviewing our workflow and QA to ensure problems like this will not happen again in the future. Making games is a complex thing, but better processes can always help 🙂
We appreciate all the support you have been giving to us! Your patience and feedback have been fundamental for us to keep improving the game.
Please keep reporting bugs or suggesting improvements in the Community Hub or in our Discord server, as we are daily following the forums and using your feedback to improve Chessarama.

(*For now, looks like closing the game and opening it again brings back the game modes and Live Challenges, but not the Campaign progress. We're already working on this issue and we're hoping to fix it in the next days)

Hey everyone!
We have lots of exciting news for you this month 💪
A better and cleaner UI was made for Campaign game tutorials.
Farm Life levels were revamped: they are more consistent with the expected difficulty with new Challenges and levels.
Street Soccer levels were also revamped: now they are more consistent with the expected difficulty as well!
Knight Supreme was changed: it's a completely new game with new Challenges! 🐴
Pawns Game was changed as well! It's now called Pawn Mania, with new rules and Challenges! 🐲
The difficulty of Battles (except for Soccer Chess) was risen up! You should face a more challenging opponent playing on Medium difficulty and above.
Fixed some UI bugs on ultrawide monitors.
Fixed the "back" button at piece details in Collection.
Fixed a bug where mouse hover coordinates were not visible with the grid on.
Fixed wrong Challenges on Farm Life level 1.
Fixed a bug where Chess sets could not be selected.
🎮 You can update your game to the 0.9.7 version on Steam!

🐞 Remember to use the Bug Report in-game to report bugs, and the Feedback Form to tell us your opinion (you can access it by clicking the "chat balloons" icon on the left higher corner of the Main Menu).
